Cross Transformer = channel_independent=True + cross_decoder=True; patch8 = kernel_size 16, conv_stride 8, n_rank 8. Signals interact only in the decoder, through the C cross-attentions per layer (cost ∝ C²).
Edge gates start as the identity (plain channel independence) and are learned per decoder layer. Loss = task loss + λ_gate · penalty() + λ_edge · edge_penalty() (mean over decoder layers).
Causality: every token at time t depends only on inputs at times ≤ t; decoder cross-attention sees all of memory and the raw tokens, which are entirely past data.
N batch, C signals, L input length, B bands, T = ceil(L / 8), T_dec = output_length·s, H = output_length, s = samples_per_output, g[i, j] = weight of signal j's update to signal i.
